description: Declared platform matrix for the self-contained sap-adt runtime. 'status' is maintained explicitly: 'verified-local' and 'verified-ci' require a real native build + install smoke on that OS/arch, locally or in CI respectively. Never mark a target verified from a script's existence alone.

windows-x86_64.notes: CLI 1.6.3 Windows x64 runtime built with Windows Python 3.12 via WSL interop on 2026-11-21; ZIP and isolated npm install passed diagnostic/debugger/execution cross-process smokes. Windows-local npm regressions: 42 passed, 5 platform-specific skips. The desktop installer was last verified for CLI 1.6.2 with Inno Setup 6.7.4; no 1.6.3 installer is supplied because the compiler is unavailable on this host. Interactive wizard, actual PATH mutation, elevated installation, live Windows SAP access and live debugger attachment are unverified.

linux-x86_64.notes: CLI 1.6.3 verified on Ubuntu 24.04 glibc 2.39 (WSL2), 2026-11-21: 486 Python and 47 npm tests, clean wheel install and native npm diagnostic/debugger/execution cross-process smokes. DEV execution verified Class Run, Report List, local function, read-only BAPI and syntax-failure cleanup; all probe objects independently verified absent. glibc floor applies to other distros; do not generalize to musl/older glibc without a real build there. Live debugger attachment is unverified.
